items.information: **There is a different venue for Day 2 and 3 of the competition: Centre Point Mall Parkson 4th Floor Centre Point Mall, Jl. Timor Blok H - I, Komplek Medan, Gang Buntu, Medan Timur, Kota Medan, Sumatera Utara 20232** Registration is capped at 80 competitors. * Friday has the following events: 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 WF, 3x3 BLD, 4x4 BLD, 5x5 BLD, MBLD, and FMC(1st Round & Final 1st Attempt). * Saturday has the following events: 5x5, Pyraminx, Clock, Square-1, Megaminx, and FMC(Final 2nd & 3rd Attempts) * Sunday has the following events: 3x3, 3x3 One-Handed, 2x2, 4x4, and Skewb. **IMPORTANT!** In accordance with articles 2g, 2k, and 2l, competitors that fail to abide by the specified WCA regulations shall be disqualified, at the discretion of the WCA delegate. For further information, please check the website or contact any of the organizers.
